expertiseSources.summary: Provides original audit guidance grounded in the Agent Skills authoring specification and conflicting primary 2026 instruction-file studies, with explicit evidence and measurement limits.

exception.rationale: The revision adds a bounded read-only event projection using explicit authorized files, finite scan/output budgets, context-aware deduplication, and distinct transport, shell, and unknown outcomes. It keeps private prompts, commands, identifiers, and payloads out of default output, detects declared coverage gaps, and never infers intended test-red status from a failure alone. Delivery gates cover the actual unpublished range. Deterministic parser tests and generic behavior cases do not establish matched model uplift or completed human approval.
